title: feat(app-shell): Packaged automation Clone opens with a proposed name and label (objectui#13344)
body:
Closes #13344
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Setup › Packaged automation: the Clone dialog used to open with both the machine name and the label empty. It now opens on `SOURCE_copy` and the translated "SOURCE LABEL (copy)". Both fields stay editable, and the dialog can be submitted as it opens.

- `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` (the Clone button's `setClone` call): the draft starts with `name` set to the source name plus `_copy`, and `label` set to the new key `packagedAutomation.cloneCopyLabel` filled with `row.label`. `row.label` is already the machine name when the flow declares no label (the row builder in `packagedFlows.ts`), so that fallback needs no new code.
- **Does the default pass the form's own name check?** Yes. The dialog's only client check is that both fields are non-blank (`cloneNameValid`). On the server, `FlowSchema.name` in `@objectstack/spec` requires the regex `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$` and sets no length limit. Adding `_copy` to a name that already matches still matches. It is also exactly the name the runtime's own taken-name refusal suggests (`suggestCloneName` in the runtime's `flow-clone.ts`).
- **A taken name** still gets the server's 409 message, shown as sent. `onCloneSubmit` is unchanged.
- **Strings:** the page's strings live in the `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs. There is one new key, `packagedAutomation.cloneCopyLabel`, in all ten packs (en, zh, ja, ko, de, es, fr, pt, ru, ar).
- One changeset: `.changeset/13344-clone-name-prefill.md`, a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

All runs are at head `d26bb5557`.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on `PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`, `PackagedAutomationPage.navContribution.test.tsx` and `PackagedActionsSection.test.tsx`: **3 files passed, 47 tests passed**.
- New describe block `the clone dialog opens on a usable default name`, with five tests:
  - the dialog opens on the defaults, the default name matches the flow-name regex, and submitting as-is sends exactly `{ name: 'pkg_notify_copy', label: 'Notify owner (copy)' }`
  - the prefill comes from the row that was clicked
  - a flow with no label falls back to its machine name
  - both fields stay editable and the typed values are sent
  - a taken default gets the server's 409 message unchanged, and the defaults stay in the fields
- Updated test: `will not submit until both the new machine name and the new label are given` now clears the prefilled fields first.
- **Ablation:** I put the page back to its base version (empty `name` and `label`) and re-ran the page test. **4 failed, 26 passed**: the four prefill tests failed, and the editability test still passed, as expected because typing works either way. Then I restored the file from `HEAD` and checked that its blob hash matched the commit and that `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: 84 files passed, 1319 tests passed, 13 skipped. This covers `all-locales-key-parity`.
- `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: 32 passed.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift` and `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: all exit 0. Drift reports 1 key added and 0 en values changed.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, 1 changeset declared.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Type-check, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, 30 of 30 tasks passed. That includes `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- ESLint on the 12 touched source files: 0 errors and 1 warning. The warning (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on the load effect's `setLoadError(null)`) was already there and is on a line this PR does not change.

## Acceptance notes

- The prefill does not try to skip names that are already taken. The list on this page shows only packaged flows, and a tenant clone is never listed there, so the page cannot know which `_copy` names exist. The server decides, and its 409 suggests a free name.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
